rationale: The interpreter output does not satisfy the ticket requirement to display the calculated height using the exact label "DX Coil Height". Instead, it uses a different label "DX height", which both omits the required label and introduces an unsupported one, constituting high‑severity issues.

findings.description: The required label "DX Coil Height" is not present in the interpreter's business rules.
findings.action: Add a business rule that displays the calculated height using the exact label "DX Coil Height" as specified in the ticket.
